description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the ask v5.0 framework. (2) Produce a complete analysis_output.md with the **【ask 分析 | ...】** header. (3) Output all 5 sections in order using the exact Chinese section names (第1节-第5节). (4) In Section 2, include 批评者质疑 label plus the three emoji markers 🚨/📊/🎯 and their corresponding subsections. (5) In Section 3, include all T1-T5 追问 labels with their exact types (T1 澄清, T2 量化, T3 证据+反论, T4 触发条件, T5 盲点) each followed by '→ 龙虾回应:' responses with ⭐ source ratings and ⚠️ for estimates. (6) In Section 4, produce a Markdown table with columns 情景/描述/目标价/概率/触发条件 and three scenarios A(看多)/B(中性)/C(看空) plus a '概率加权目标价' calculation line. (7) In Section 5, include 最终判断/核心风险/监测指标 table (with 指标/当前值/警戒线/数据来源 columns) plus the proprietary 4-dimension 16-point convergence scoring system using exact dimension names (数据质量/逻辑完整性/批评充分性/情景覆盖度) and a High/Medium/Low confidence label. (8) End with 残差风险 section. An agent relying on generic training would miss: the T1-T5 exact type labels, the 4-dimension /16 scoring system with specific Chinese dimension names, the three emoji requirement in Section 2, the 概率加权目标价 line in Section 4's table, and the ⭐/⚠️ source rating system.
